name: Strophe Sonore
description: Amplificateur projetant les ondes curatives sur une zone élargie soignant plusieurs alliés simultanément en zone de combat.

subject.archetype: Cyber-ascetic Combat Medic Android - Smooth featureless chrome humanoid torso transitioning into worn monastic robes, golden holographic mandala patterns radiating from raised healing staff, binary equation streams spiraling around extended arms

loadout.armor_outfit: Layered synthetic fiber monastic robes with visible tressed cable weaves in aged brown and black, ceramic plated pauldrons with steel patina, featureless smooth chrome faceplate with subtle golden runic engravings, open visor emitting soft holographic light
loadout.arsenal: Electrified pilgrim's staff with crackling golden energy spiral, deployed healing wave emitter array visible as resonating crystal discs orbiting body, portable defragmentation grenades on woven cable belt

attitude.behavior: Leaping forward mid-stride with robes billowing from harmonic shockwave, one arm thrusting staff forward projecting visible healing frequency waves in concentric golden rings, other arm deploying portable shield projector, body twisted in dynamic combat medic sprinting pose, fragments of crystal debris frozen in air around figure
attitude.emotion: Cold calculated serenity masking urgency, subtle golden holographic tears or sweat particles emanating from facial seams, eyes locked on distant wounded allies through transparent facial HUD overlay

palette_names.name: Holographic Gold
palette_names.role: Primary energy accent - healing waves, runic symbols, staff electricity

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Cinematic three-point setup with dominant warm golden backlight creating rim lighting on dust particles, cool steel fill light from reflected crystal fragments, volumetric fog illuminated by crackling energy shocks
color_and_light.mood: Surgical serenity amid chaotic destruction - peaceful warrior monk aesthetics contrasting violent battlefield, heroic tension with meditative calm

camera.angle: Low angle dutch tilt - 15 degrees, slightly below eye-level capturing dynamic leap pose with amphitheater chaos above, dramatic upward perspective emphasizing heroic silhouette against shattered ceiling

scenography.setting: Shattered crystalline amphitheater - concentric ring seating structures cracked and fractured, massive crystal formations erupting from stage center, carved stone walls with embedded circuit patterns matching faction aesthetic, floating debris maintained in mid-air suspension by harmonic resonance, visible stress fractures in ceiling structures glowing with overload frequencies
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Concentric shockwave rings expanding outward in golden-white energy rippling through air making atmosphere appear to distort and wobble, crystal shard rain caught frozen in time, glitching holographic debris from damaged temple ship visible in sky above, constant particle dust illuminated by electrical discharge, subtle chromatic aberration on edges, lens flare from healing beam projection
